entities.name: Query protein HMBPP reductase
observations: 399 aa protein; exact sequence hash match to reviewed UniProt A5GIF7 from Synechococcus sp. WH7803.
Contains a LYTB domain (PF02401) spanning residues 57–392.
Binds one [4Fe-4S] cluster per subunit; curated GO includes 4Fe-4S cluster binding and metal ion binding.

entities.name: HMBPP to IPP and DMAPP
observations: HMBPP reductase catalyzes conversion of HMBPP into a mixture of isopentenyl diphosphate and dimethylallyl diphosphate.
The reaction is the terminal step of the DOXP/MEP pathway and uses a [4Fe-4S] enzyme with reducing equivalents supplied by ferredoxin.

entities.name: MEP isoprenoid pathway
observations: The enzyme performs the terminal step of methylerythritol phosphate/DOXP isoprenoid biosynthesis.
Products IPP and DMAPP feed terpenoid and broader isoprenoid biosynthesis.
